propositions: _paged_search lacks an offset-stall guard and loops infinitely when the DC server ignores startAt and repeats the same page instead of advancing
Fail-open exception handlers at get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment sites swallow pagination stalls silently instead of propagating them
The pager must raise a dedicated BackendPaginationStallError when a server stops advancing the startAt offset, detected by comparing successive pages' first issue keys
Adopting fetcher's short-page branch would incorrectly return partial results on DC where every page is capped short by design
The stall error must live in core _backend.py so both DC adapter and fetcher can name it without circular imports
All four fail-open sites require explicit re-raise of BackendPaginationStallError ahead of broad Exception handlers to ensure loud termination
